propositions: Plan-review Pass 1 currently can serialize failed criteria as empty successes and checkpoint them without capturing policy, prompt, contract, and topology inputs, losing operational context
RP-06 must replace the current checkpoint serialization with a journaled shared discovery execution that preserves partial successes while invalidating failed or corrupt envelopes

The new checkpoint identity must include plan material, code/ref, criteria snapshot, prompt/contract, model/mode, topology, context, dependencies, and namespace version so that any input change forces a recompute

Failed local units must not produce reusable checkpoints; earlier successes must survive, independent work must continue, dependents must skip, and the final verdict must follow the approved failure policy
The review journal must store the safe versioned trace and digest-complete success-only envelopes while `review-plan` outputs remain narrow end-result contracts with no per-unit trace
